results.title: empty script
results.methodology: Same-process runs of real Rhino scripts. Each run's engines are tracked from EngineLifecycleCallback.onEngineCreate to onEngineRemove through weak references only. After every run the runner calls Runtime.gc and System.runFinalization 3 times and polls up to pollMs (1 s once 3 runs stayed reachable); a final collection decides 'retained'. Heap deltas compare the sample after the last warm-up with the final sample; thread, Rhino context and engine deltas compare with the sample before the first run. Force mode waits for gateReady() (and all expected engines), sleeps forceDelayMs and calls forceStop on every live engine of the run on the main thread. Measurements are the temporary test implementation of ROADMAP P0.2. Native detail (ROADMAP P3.1): host counters of images, open media images and Mats after every run, the native heap peak sampled every 20 ms inside each run, dumpsys meminfo of this process (through the UiAutomation shell) and VMDebug instance counts at the start, after the warm-ups and at the end; images and open media images must return to the start and live Mats to the value after the warm-ups. One toast before the first sample of the process initializes the render pipeline (ROADMAP P3 N1). ROADMAP P4.4: scenarios may also limit the growth of VMDebug instance counts and host counters after the warm-ups (classes, DEX loaders, WebViews) and require script statistics to stay 0.

results.methodology: Same-process runs of real Rhino scripts. Each run's engines are tracked from EngineLifecycleCallback.onEngineCreate to onEngineRemove through weak references only. After every run the runner calls Runtime.gc and System.runFinalization 3 times and polls up to pollMs (1 s once 3 runs stayed reachable); a final collection decides 'retained'. Heap deltas compare the sample after the last warm-up with the final sample; thread, Rhino context and engine deltas compare with the sample before the first run. Force mode waits for gateReady() (and all expected engines), sleeps forceDelayMs and calls forceStop on every live engine of the run on the main thread. Measurements are the temporary test implementation of ROADMAP P0.2.
